senses.definition: (Ireland, US, England) A liquor distilled from the fermented mash of grain (as rye, corn, or barley).

quotes.text: The exceſſive drinking of ſpirituous liquours, eſpecially whiſkey, is now become ſo common, that more people are killed by them, than by ſmall-pox, fevers, broken limbs, accidents, and all other diſtempers put together. And we are credibly informed, that in one dram ſhop only in this town, there are 120 gallons of that accurſed ſpirit, whiſkey, ſold.
quotes.reference: 1753 September 25, “Historical Chronicle”, in The Gentleman's Magazine, volume XXIII, number VIII, London, page 391:

senses.definition: (Ireland, US, England) A drink of whiskey.
(international standards) Alternative letter-case form of Whiskey from the NATO/ICAO Phonetic Alphabet.
(historical) A light gig or carriage drawn by one horse.
